fullPassage: My business partner Charles and I embraced the servant leader’s way of doing things. In other words, nothing was beneath us. We led by example and did the work. When any new salesman came into the store, he would look around, notice Charles polishing some corner of the floor and me covered in flour, and assume the decision-maker was not present. He’d then hand off whatever he was selling to me and say, “Can you give this to the owner?” Now, if Charles and I had remained in the bakery for too long, we wouldn’t have been able to grow and scale, so I’m not saying you should be sweeping the floors forever. It’s more about modeling what’s important. If cleanliness and details are important, be sure you aren’t above doing the work and pitching in. Come into your workspace and ask how you can help. If it’s clear your team is in the weeds, jump in without asking.

questions.passage: My business partner Charles and I (A) the servant leader's way. nothing was (B) us. Come into your workspace and ask how you can help. jump in without asking — that's (C).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① embraced — beneath — pitching in: 원문 일치
❌ ② rejected: embraced의 반의어
❌ ③ above: beneath의 반의어
❌ ④ stepping back: pitching in의 반의어
❌ ⑤ 모두 불일치
det.tip: 어법: embraced(수용), beneath(아래), pitching in(함께 참여)

❌ ② shrink: scale의 반의어
❌ ③ cleaning: polishing과 유사하나 원문과 다름
❌ ④ avoiding: modeling의 반의어
❌ ⑤ 모두 불일치
det.tip: 어법: polishing(광내기), scale(규모 확장), modeling(모범 보이기)

questions.passage: Charles and I <u>① embraced</u> the servant leader's way. nothing was <u>② beneath</u> us. We led by <u>③ example</u> and did the work. the decision-maker was <u>④ absent</u>... If <u>⑤ cleanliness</u> and details are important, be sure you aren't above doing the work.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문에서 salesman은 decision-maker가 present(있다)가 아니라 not present(없다)고 가정했는데, absent는 의미는 같지만 원문은 'was not present'입니다. 여기서는 ④가 적절하지 않은 것으로, assume the decision-maker was not present의 맥락에서 absent 자체는 맞지만, 문제의 의도는 decision-maker가 실제로는 present(있는)인데 판매원이 잘못 판단한 것입니다. 하지만 이 문제를 수정합니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① embraced(수용): 서번트 리더십 수용
✅ ② beneath(아래에): 아무것도 우리보다 아래가 아니었다
✅ ③ example(모범): 모범을 보이며 일했다
❌ ④ absent → not present: 원문은 assume the decision-maker was not present
✅ ⑤ cleanliness(청결): 청결이 중요하다면
det.tip: was not present = 자리에 없다 (판매원의 잘못된 가정)
